programs.description: A naive clerk observes the decadent lives of a fading zamindar family. He is drawn to the lonely wife, who yearns for love amid her husband's decline and their shared ruin.
The host plays devotional songs that praise the Almighty and imbues oneself with peace and tranquility and explores various places of worship.

A rich man hires detective Byomkesh Bakshi to investigate an eloped movie actress. However, the case gets complicated when the rich man is murdered by someone.
Gopal Bhar is appointed as a jester in Raja Krishnachandra's court in medieval Bengal. His wit and humour are well-known in the region and his exploits always have a significant social message.
Ratan, an honest autorickshaw driver, refuses to help a corrupt politician, Pradip Roy, which then leads to a local war. He also ends up falling in love with Jhilik, his daughter.
Raja, a con man, falls in love with Sumi, who leaves him after she learns about his lies. Soon, Raja starts living with Abhay Charan, and his daughter, who has blood cancer, falls for him.
When Nupur's marriage is fixed without her consent, she runs away from her home in Delhi and meets Anjan in Kolkata. Meanwhile, detectives Bhanu and Jahar are hired to find the missing bride.
Paramhansa, a poor but wise man called Borobaba, leads a community. When terrorism strikes and police are helpless, he steps in to save the area.
